we cloned LAT2, the l‐Dopa transporter in the LLC‐PK cell line, which is a model for the proximal tubule of the kidney, a major site for l‐Dopa uptake and metabolism.

we cloned the gene encoding LAT2 in the pig renal LLC‐ PK1 cell line, and then used small interfering RNA duplex (siRNA) molecules to suppress LAT2 expression and thereby study the role of LAT2 in l‐DOPa transport in LLC‐PK cells.

the LAT2 transporter, which is highly expressed in the kidney and in the small intestine, is the main transporter of l‐Dopa in the kidney, as demonstrated by our gene silencing experiments.
